visualCharacteristics.purpose: Listing band of 2-up post tiles with round pager links
visualCharacteristics.layout: Grey band, centred column, 2-up post tiles, round page links

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: picture | date | title link (cells in any order; image optional), then an optional pager row

usage: Blog, events and news listing pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse post-list for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
